motion.value: opacity 0, y 14px, blur 6px -> rest, 0.7s, once in view

motion.name: border-beam
motion.value: conic light around the border, 7s loop

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Amber button, 12px radius, shine sweep on hover, arrow nudges right.

narrative.overview: A soft dark, readable site for artisans: normal-size sentence-case headings, warm charcoal surfaces, one amber accent, real client screenshots, and light one-time motion. Replaces the earlier neon creative-agency canon.
keyCharacteristics: Real client sites in device frames
Light motion: blur fade, rotating word, border beam, shine

rules.name: Readable first
rules.body: Headings stay at documented sizes; no uppercase display type.

rules.name: No scroll-linked motion
rules.body: Animations play once or loop gently; nothing is scrubbed to the scroll position.

rules.name: Client colour
rules.body: Case studies use the client's brand colour only on the live-site button.
